findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "trust_check_wallet" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "trust_check_wallet" is 1389 chars, far longer than this server's median (235). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "hire" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trust_check_wallet, hiring_how_it_works · Private data: trust_check_wallet · Public sink: trust_check_wallet, hiring_publish_my_services, hiring_send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trust_check_wallet, hiring_how_it_works · Private data: trust_check_wallet · Public sink: trust_check_wallet, hiring_publish_my_services, hiring_send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
